goal: Make a prose-only handoff avoid the inapplicable disposable database contract test while preserving every other merge safeguard.
prohibited_actions: No database, preview, production, repository-setting, or orchestrator-marker mutation.
No reviewer bypass, required-context removal, or merge-path replacement.
Do not change paths outside this contract.
assumptions: PR #2592 remains the source of the documents-only contract exemption and is not rebuilt.
The protected base revision is the only executable policy allowed to make the inapplicability decision.
Automatic guarded dispatch and ownership fencing remain later milestones.
stop_conditions: A required check fails or the trusted classifier cannot read the complete pull-request file list.
Main movement invalidates the branch evidence.
The change would require a database, production, security-setting, or live-orchestrator action.
